units.source_zh: 长安已穿上了草屐，朝来时所乘轿子走了去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 按针茫然看看那只黄金鸡，忙站起身送长安。长安已穿上了草屐，朝来时所乘轿子走了去。

paragraphs.source_en: The moment the palanquin passed through the gate of the Miura residence, Chōan ordered them to go to the “Asakusa Dispensary,” then added almost breathlessly, “The beggars’ infirmary, the outcasts’ infirmary—the one Sotelo established!”

units.source_en: The moment the palanquin passed through the gate of the Miura residence, Chōan ordered them to go to the “Asakusa Dispensary,” then added almost breathlessly, “The beggars’ infirmary, the outcasts’ infirmary—the one Sotelo established!”
units.source_zh: 轿子刚一出三浦府大门，长安立刻吩咐至“浅草施药院”，然后又气短似的加了一句：“乞丐药院，贱民药院，索德罗开的那个！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 轿子刚一出三浦府大门，长安立刻吩咐至“浅草施药院”，然后又气短似的加了一句：“乞丐药院，贱民药院，索德罗开的那个！”

paragraphs.source_en: Besides the palanquin bearers, two attendants accompanied him: one carried a spear, the other his footwear. For Chōan, this was an unusually modest retinue. That was precisely why he had not fixed his route in advance.

units.source_en: Besides the palanquin bearers, two attendants accompanied him: one carried a spear, the other his footwear.
units.source_zh: 除了轿夫外，还有两个侍从，一个拿枪，一个提鞋。

units.source_en: For Chōan, this was an unusually modest retinue.
units.source_zh: 这对长安来说乃是罕见的小排场。

units.source_en: That was precisely why he had not fixed his route in advance.

ja.t: めていなかったのである。

units.source_zh: 也正因如此，他才未事先定下出行路线。

paragraphs.source_zh: 除了轿夫外，还有两个侍从，一个拿枪，一个提鞋。这对长安来说乃是罕见的小排场。也正因如此，他才未事先定下出行路线。

paragraphs.source_en: Seated in the palanquin, Chōan thought over these things and could not help smiling faintly.

units.source_en: Seated in the palanquin, Chōan thought over these things and could not help smiling faintly.
units.source_zh: 长安坐在轿中，想着这些，不由微微笑了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 长安坐在轿中，想着这些，不由微微笑了。
